title: NAS security mode command accepted by the UE

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE processes SECURITY MODE COMMAND message and responds with SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message to establish NAS security context.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by network to UE to initiate NAS security mode control procedure.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network to complete NAS security mode control procedure.

entities.name: Replayed UE security capabilities
entities.description: IE containing UE security capabilities replayed from previous UE transmission.

entities.name: NAS key set identifier
entities.description: IE containing ngKSI value identifying the security context.

entities.name: Additional 5G security information
entities.description: IE containing additional security parameters including horizontal derivation parameter and RINMR bit.

entities.name: NAS message container
entities.description: IE used to carry retransmitted initial NAS messages in SECURITY MODE COMPLETE.

entities.name: 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Security context containing keys, algorithms, and counters for NAS security operations.

entities.name: Integrity check passed
entities.description: Condition where SECURITY MODE COMMAND message passes integrity verification.

entities.name: Emergency services condition
entities.description: Condition where UE is registered for emergency services or establishing emergency PDU session.

entities.name: 5G-IA0 null integrity protection algorithm
entities.description: Null integrity protection algorithm that provides no integrity protection.

entities.name: NAS COUNT counter
entities.description: Counter used for NAS message sequencing and integrity protection.

relations.description: Security mode control procedure involves receiving SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.
Security mode control procedure involves sending SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message contains Replayed UE security capabilities IE.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message contains NAS key set identifier IE.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message may contain Additional 5G security information IE.
SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message may contain NAS message container IE for retransmitted initial messages.
Successful integrity check establishes that 5G NAS security context can be taken into use.
Emergency services condition guards acceptance of 5G-IA0 null integrity protection algorithm.
Security mode control procedure resets uplink NAS COUNT counter under specified conditions.
SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message requires integrity protection and ciphering using the new 5G NAS security context.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message triggers integrity check action.
